reason: The permitted external only supplies an amplified four-corner datum, and def-four-corner-merging-datum says merely that such a datum has four corner maps; neither input identifies their target corner spaces with the raw products Q_i A_R Q_j asserted here. Since A_R is only an extended epsilon-C*-algebra, its multiplication is not assumed associative, so Q_i A_R Q_j is unbracketed and cannot silently be identified with the compressed or cross-corner spaces produced by the construction. Thus the displayed map typing uses a forbidden associativity or corner-identification assumption and is not justified by the allowed dependencies.
